content: Karriwayinin Kore Nawu Kawohrnan Rowk Kanngehkengkenh.
Bu Yawey kanbebkeng kadberre kore karribongdibeh, dja kandurndiweng kore kunred Zion, wanjh ngad karriyimi yiman karridjalbukirrinang bu kamak rowk.

Karrimarrmarrni dja karridjaldjekmeng bu munguyh. Karriwayini mankong manbu kunnjilngmakkenh. Bininj nawu birridjenbuyika, wanjh kandiyolyolmeng kadberre dja birriyimeng, “Nawu Yawey benmarnekurduyimeng kundjalwern kundulkarre nuye dorrengh!”
Woybukkih, nungka nawu Yawey kanmarnekurduyimeng kunkimuk, dja karridjalwernhnjilngmakminj duninjh.
O Yawey, kanwon kunmak nawu ngarriwarrhmeng, kanmarnbun ba ngarriyimerran yiman kayime mankabo kaborlobme kore kunbolk kubolkdarleh kabolkngeyyo Negev.
Bininj nawu manmim kaburriwe bu karrudjeng kurorre, wanjh kunubewu kanalkkihre bu karrurrkmirri. Kaluk yerre bu kadjolengmang manwern nuye, wanjh nungka kawayini dja kahmarrmarr duninjh.
Yoh, bininj nawu kabirrire kabirrikan manmim bu kabirridudjeng, kabirrinalkihre dorrengh, wanjh kabirrimdurndeng kabirrimkan manbu mandjoleng manwern, dja wanjh kabirriwayini bu kabirrinjilngmak.
